Function Call Argument Information

Source: R/type-metadata.R
call_argument.Rd

Represents information about an argument in a function call, including its inferred type, position, and optional name (for named arguments). Used during static type checking to validate function calls.

Usage

call_argument(
  node = (function (.data) 
 {
    
    stop(sprintf("S3 class <%s> doesn't have a constructor", class[[1]]), call. =
    FALSE)
 })(),
  type = character(0),
  position = integer(0),
  name = character(0)
)

Fields

node

XML node representing the argument expression

type

Character string with inferred type (e.g., "class_integer", "unknown")

position

Integer position of the argument (1-indexed)

name

Character string with argument name for named arguments, or NULL for positional
